calendar.previous: Names the arrow button that steps the calendar back one month, week or page.
calendar.next: Names the arrow button that steps the calendar forward one month, week or page.
calendar.pick_date: Names the hidden date input behind the calendar heading, which opens the browser’s date picker.

common.finding_classes: Read once while a list of places or classes is loading, in place of the placeholder rows drawn on screen.

event.view_photo: Names a photo in an event’s image carousel that has no description of its own; activating it opens the photo full size.
event.pause_slideshow: Names the toggle button that stops the image carousel advancing on its own. The name stays the same whether paused or not; the button’s pressed state carries that.
event.copy_address: Names the button on a class page that copies the venue’s street, town and postcode; the address itself is read right after it, as “Copy address: 120 Heath St, London NW3 1DR”.

filters.remove: Names the remove button on an active-filter chip. `%{label}` = the filter’s own label.

search.results_showing: Announced after more results load. `%{shown}` = results now listed, `%{total}` = results found.
search.dismiss_nearby_prompt: Names the close button on the “use my location” prompt, which hides it for this visit.

share.copy_link: Names the button that copies the event link; the link itself is read right after it, as “Copy link: https://…”.
share.share_on: Names one share button. `%{platform}` = the platform’s name, e.g. WhatsApp.
share.qr_code: Names the QR code image of the class link, which hosts print on posters. `%{title}` = the class title, e.g. “Evening Meditation at The Hut”.
